description: This file defines the ImplicitStreamPubSub class, which implements the IStreamPubSub interface to manage implicit pub/sub subscriptions in Orleans streaming, including registration, deregistration, and subscription enumeration.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamPubSub
classes.description: Implements implicit publish-subscribe functionality for Orleans streams, handling registration and lookup of subscriptions based on stream IDs and Grain IDs.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specific stream ID and returns its subscriptions.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: No-op for unregistering a producer in implicit pub/sub.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer subscription, ensuring it is implicit.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer subscription, only if implicit.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns zero; implicit pub/sub does not track producer counts.

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns zero; implicit pub/sub does not track consumer counts.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a stream, possibly filtered by consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a subscription ID for a given stream and Grain ID, based on implicit subscription GUIDs.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Always returns false; no fault handling implemented.
